department: Doctoral Programme in Molecular and Cellular Systems of Life (MaCS)

deadline.value: The programme admits four times a year; the 2026-27 rounds close 16 November 2026, 25 January 2027 and 15 April 2027, and the earliest is listed.
deadline.quote: until 16 November 2026 at 03:00 PM EEST | Application periods in spring 2027: | 12-25 January 2027 | 2-15 April 2027

also.quote: The programme admits new doctoral researchers four times year

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

supervisor.value: Each applicant must have a supervisor or supervisors when submitting the application, including one docent-level supervisor.
supervisor.quote: The doctoral programme requires that each applicant must have a supervisor or supervisors when submitting the application

also.quote: One supervisor holding the title of a docent or equivalent academic qualifications is required

funding.value: Funding for the first year must be secured at application; the page does not say admitted students are funded.
funding.quote: Funding for the first year, starting from the beginning of the study right, must be secured

entry_route.value: Applicants need a second-cycle university degree or an equivalent foreign education.

notes: Four application rounds a year. Neurobiology is one of its listed fields of science; it is covered by the biomed record's neuro entry.
